author: Zephyrred42
quote: I've been a pokemon fan for a great many years, ever since diamond and pearl which was my first pokemon games and I gotta say I love the freedom that this game gives you. I feel like a real pokemon trainer roaming the world and hoping to find specific pokemon! playing it on NS2 even makes it a way better experience! Its black and white! get it? lol- but yeah I like to just replay this game whenever i feel like playin some pokemon- either this or soulsilver!

author: Zephyrred42
quote: This is my first Metroid game and I can say I'm hooked. I will be playing the older prime games as well! Samus is an awesome silent protagonist and yet you can understand her via her movements- great silent story telling- I can't wait for more!

author: Zephyrred42
quote: Okay! this is my first 2D sidescroller Metroid game and I gotta say, I adore this series! I consider myself a fan now and Im gonna go back and play every entry i missed! This series is Awesome!!

author: Zephyrred42
quote: This wasn't just a game. This was an experience- Hoping a character or series you love would get a character in this game! Watching directs excited to see who would join the roster- I Loved every second! Also yes, My most wanted characters got in being Joker from Persona, Sora from Kingdom Hearts and of course Hero (Erdrick Specifically) from Dragon Quest!! I love Dragon Quest and when he was revealed, I was screamin like crazy!

author: Zephyrred42
quote: Ngl I know this game isnt made for everyone but I can happily say it was made for me! This is the kind of Hybrid gameplay I was hoping for!! I Love the legends gameplay where u can catch pokemon in the city! I can't wait for more pokemon!

author: Zephyrred42
quote: Dude this game feels like I'm finally playing in the world of the Pokemon Manga specifically! Where pokemon are more dangerous, they attack the player- this is a game I been hoping for for a very long time! Thank you Pokemon Co!!

author: Zephyrred42
quote: I have loved Dragon Quest all throughout my childhood and I gotta say this game, despite knowing I was gonna love it-- Blew me out of the water. I started it, and If i wasnt at work or sleeping I did nothing but play it for the 100+ hours til I beat it- I love the whimsical classic fun world of Dragon Quest and this game allows you to embrace your creativity! My favorite JRPG of all time now.

author: Zephyrred42
quote: I knew i was gonna love this game, and yet I was still blown away by how much fun I had with this game! I completed it and I already wanna hop back in again! I adore this magical, creative and fun world! I went to the midnight release too! The whole experience for this game was amazing.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Zephyrred42
quote: This is my first pikmin game and I'm not gonna lie, I'm legit hooked! the Pikmin are adorable- and I feel like I can sink in my chair and play for hours! its so addicting! I can't wait to explore more of the series!
game_title: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy

author: Zephyrred42
quote: The graphics are the only good thing about this game. I'm sorry but 8hours of chores? This is supposed to be GTA- you should be enjoying your freedom and destroying whatever you want too- GTA 6 feels like a sims game compared to GTA 5. not to mention its got more bugs than a bugs life despite all the delays and the budget. I dont know what critics gave this game a 100 but I feel like they need to be replaced. and then theres the double standard- Other games have budgets way lower than this game and yet when they launched with bugs they were dragged through the mud. and this game isnt? because its GTA? C'mon man. Very Over Hyped, and barely fun. Try it for yourself if you'd like and I hope you enjoy it more than i did. Uninstalled and trying to get my refund.
